# NEW 2026-11-17 theme-rework stage 3: theme revolts and theme works.
# Generated by gen_theme_revolt_works.py from 《军区详细设计》; edit the generator and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

# Theme scope. Monthly: pending chain revolt, warning, yearly revolt roll.
oe_theme_revolt_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now
        oe_theme_revolt_start = yes
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty var:oe_theme_loyalty < 30 NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_warned } country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_warned years = 5 }
            save_scope_as = oe_theme_warn_scope
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_target value = scope:oe_theme_warn_scope } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_revolt.1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty var:oe_theme_loyalty < 20 has_variable = oe_theme_tenure var:oe_theme_tenure >= 36 NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_cd } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_cd months = 12 }
            random = { chance = oe_theme_revolt_chance oe_theme_revolt_start = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Author's rules: rebels rise in the jurisdiction; troops and money go to the rebels; the theme is abolished.
oe_theme_revolt_start = {
    oe_tw_on_revolt = yes # OUTER (gen_territory_outer.py): mark the jurisdiction as former provinces
    save_scope_as = oe_revolt_theme
    if = { limit = { exists = ruler } ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_revolt_strategos } }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_to_list = oe_revolt_locations }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_revolt_gold value = gold }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_revolt_manpower value = manpower }
    c:BYZ = {
        # A theme rebel state still at war: later revolts join it (a second civil war cannot start meanwhile).
        if = {
            limit = { in_civil_war = yes var:oe_theme_revolt_country ?= { at_war = yes } }
            var:oe_theme_revolt_country = { save_scope_as = oe_revolt_country }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_revolt_joined value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            create_rebel = { category = estate estate = nobles_estate name = OE_THEME_REBEL_NAME save_scope_as = oe_revolt_rebels }
            every_in_list = {
                list = oe_revolt_locations
                every_pop = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_revolt_rebels }
            }
            scope:oe_revolt_rebels = { start_civil_war = { save_scope_as = oe_revolt_country } }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_revolt_country }
        every_in_list = {
            list = oe_revolt_locations
            if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_location_owner = scope:oe_revolt_country }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_center } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_region_lockout years = 5 } }
        }
        every_army = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_revolt_country }
        every_navy = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_revolt_country }
        scope:oe_revolt_country = { add_gold = scope:oe_revolt_gold add_manpower = scope:oe_revolt_manpower }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_revolt_gold multiply = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_revolt_strategos }
            scope:oe_revolt_strategos = { move_country = scope:oe_revolt_country }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_revolt_joined } } scope:oe_revolt_country = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_revolt_strategos } }
        }
        # Other themes already in the 'treason' band may follow next month.
        c:BYZ = {
            every_subject = {
                limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_revolt_theme } var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ts_feud } }
                random = { chance = 25 set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            }
            set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_country value = scope:oe_revolt_country }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_revolt.2
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_revolt_theme reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly: when the civil war is over, all themes get the deterrence bonus for 10 years.
oe_theme_revolt_byz_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active in_civil_war = no }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_theme_deterrence years = 10 }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Starts work i in the most populous suitable jurisdiction location (castles prefer border locations).
oe_theme_works_start_1 = { # 修筑要塞
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_foreign_building_location = { oe_theme_works_location_1 = yes is_border = yes } }
        ordered_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { oe_theme_works_location_1 = yes is_border = yes } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_works_loc }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { oe_theme_works_location_1 = yes } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_works_loc }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_works_loc }
        add_gold = { value = oe_theme_works_cost_1 multiply = -1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_proj value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_proj_months value = oe_theme_works_months_1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_proj_loc value = scope:oe_works_loc }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_idle value = 0 }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Finishes the current work: the building is built instantly for BYZ (already paid by the theme).
oe_theme_works_complete = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_proj_loc }
        save_scope_as = oe_works_owner
        var:oe_theme_proj_loc = {
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 1 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:castle } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:castle owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 2 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:granary } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:granary owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
                else_if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:village_granary } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:village_granary owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 3 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:marketplace } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:marketplace owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 4 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:barracks } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:barracks owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 5 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:aqueduct_system } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:aqueduct_system owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_works_owner.var:oe_theme_proj ?= 6 }
                if = { limit = { can_build_building = building_type:orthodox_monastery } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:orthodox_monastery owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_theme_proj
    remove_variable = oe_theme_proj_months
    remove_variable = oe_theme_proj_loc
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_idle value = 0 }
}

# Theme scope. Automatic choice when idle: by focus first, then a general order.
oe_theme_works_auto = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 1 oe_theme_works_can_1 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 1 oe_theme_works_can_4 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 2 oe_theme_works_can_3 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 2 oe_theme_works_can_2 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 3 oe_theme_works_can_6 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 3 oe_theme_works_can_2 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 4 oe_theme_works_can_3 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 4 oe_theme_works_can_6 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 5 oe_theme_works_can_5 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 5 oe_theme_works_can_1 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 5 oe_theme_works_can_2 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_2 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_3 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_4 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_1 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_6 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_theme_works_can_5 = yes } oe_theme_works_start_5 = yes }
}

# Theme scope. Monthly works progress; a lost work location cancels the work without refund.
oe_theme_works_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_proj }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_proj_loc ?= { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }
            remove_variable = oe_theme_proj remove_variable = oe_theme_proj_months remove_variable = oe_theme_proj_loc
        }
        else = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_theme_proj_months add = -1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_proj_months <= 0 } oe_theme_works_complete = yes }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_idle } change_variable = { name = oe_theme_idle add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_idle value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_idle >= 12 OR = { var:oe_theme_tier_5 ?= 2 var:oe_theme_tier_5 ?= 3 } } oe_theme_works_auto = yes }
    }
}
